passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 208 (the wielder removes a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 on tag 1474064594 (Arts Reaction: the parent tag of the reaction statuses, as Liino's batch-1 report reads it) → buff_wpn_sword_0018_atk_up (attribute 2 formulaItem 6 atk_up, `duration`; stackingType 2, max max_stack: each layer its own duration). Description: "After the wielder consumes an Arts Reaction, ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s".

Not in any log or fixture yet. Open: whether a Shatter by the wielder (Solidification ended by a physical status) counts as consuming a reaction (batch-3 A7, in-game test 63): here no (a Shatter is not a statusConsumed event).
